Social engagement · Messaging automation · Loyalty acquisition · Winter 2024–25

A 15-day giveaway: 2M+ reach, 2,000+ new followers

Seven prizes over 15 days, one every other day. Every comment triggered an automated DM that turned entrants into rewards members.

2M+reach from 7 posts
2,000+new followers
~1,000new rewards members
MechanicLike, comment and share to enter; new prize every other day
The hook7 winners, but every entrant had a reason to join rewards
The offer100 welcome + 200 bonus points = a free fries
The systemAutomated DM sent to every commenter
Entry-to-member journeyautomated DM on every comment
  1. PostPrize announced, every other day7 prize posts across 15 days
  2. EnterLike, comment and shareEach entry spreads the post to new audiences
  3. AutoInstant DM to the commenter"Wait for the winner announcement, and join rewards today for 200 bonus points"
  4. JoinRewards sign-up100 welcome + 200 bonus = 300 points, a free fries
  5. RetainEnters loyalty journeysAn owned contact the brand can reach again
